description: Appends one command to a battle's log, only when expectedSeq equals the battle's current seq from get_my_battle. The answer's result.outcome is appended, stale (someone recorded first: read the battle again) or refused with the reason. Any seated player may record for any seat with playerId, as at a shared table. Each command kind says when it is used; follow get_my_battle's next for the order. Requires mcp:write.

oneOf.description: Format step: changes only the battle settings given and keeps the rest.

limit.description: Battle size in points: 1000, 2000 or 3000, or 600 for King of the Colosseum; null takes it from the rosters, where each side plays to its lists added together and the bigger side sets the size.

manual.description: true tracks the battle by hand, without mission cards, stratagems or CP automation.

missionPackId.description: A mission pack id from list_reference; null for none.

twistId.description: A twist id the chosen pack prints; null for none.

oneOf.description: Armies step: fields a saved roster on a seat, frozen as it is now. A place you play yourself fields one of your rosters.

rosterId.description: A roster id from list_my_rosters, built for this battle size.
